_lisez_moi: Text of the guided-steps questions (public/js/parcours.js). Same keys as src/contenu/fr/parcours.json.

activite.titre: In a few sentences, what does your company do?
activite.aide: We’ve prepared a draft: edit it freely.
activite.pourquoi: It’s the first thing a buyer reads: your trades, your products or services, your customers.

distinctions.titre: What sets you apart from your competitors?
distinctions.pourquoi: A buyer looks for what makes the company hard to copy. Without an answer, the chapter shows “To be completed”.

equipe.titre: Can your team run day to day without you?
equipe.pourquoi: The buyer wants to know what depends on you: that’s what they will have to take over or organize.

encadrement.libelle: Is there a management layer in place?

histoire.aide: One line per date: “year: what happened”. Add what’s missing (expansion, new trade, acquisition).
histoire.pourquoi: The memorandum’s timeline: it shows the company’s continuity.

operation.titre: What do you want to sell, and when?
operation.pourquoi: The scope and timeline of the deal, presented without any price.

part_cedee.requis: the share of the capital being sold

remuneration.aide: To compare with what a salaried manager would cost. Including payroll taxes, per year.
remuneration.pourquoi: The gap with normal pay is an EBITDA adjustment, and therefore affects the value.

remuneration_normative.libelle: What a manager replacing you would cost (leave blank if you don’t know)

detention.titre: How do you hold your shares in the company?
detention.pourquoi: The legal structure chart and the scope of the sale.

locaux.aide: A buyer always asks: are they also buying the premises, or becoming a tenant?
locaux.pourquoi: The premises are in or out of scope; an unusual rent is adjusted.

murs_cession.libelle: Are the premises part of the sale?

loyer_paye.libelle: Annual rent paid by the company

loyer_marche.libelle: Annual market rent for equivalent premises

exceptionnel.titre: Did a one-off expense or income affect your latest accounts?
exceptionnel.aide: For example: a dispute, an insurance claim, a one-time grant.
exceptionnel.pourquoi: An item that won’t recur is neutralized in adjusted EBITDA.

clients.pourquoi: Customer concentration and recurrence are closely examined by every buyer.

part_premier_client.libelle: Share of revenue from your largest customer

principaux_clients.aide: No names at all: they will appear as “Customer 1” to “Customer 5”. An estimate is enough; leave blank what you don’t know.
principaux_clients.pourquoi: The table of the top five customers, anonymized.

perspectives.titre: How do you see the next 5 years?
perspectives.aide: An average annual estimate is enough.
perspectives.pourquoi: The growth drivers a buyer could pursue; presented as your estimate.

cession.titre: How do you see the handover?
cession.pourquoi: The support you offer reassures the buyer about keeping the customers and the know-how.
